ana: Quick heads-up — expo sample app running in edge runtime fails auth retries when KV shims are enabled.

ana: Steps to repro:
1) expo init -> added redwood-inference-js SDK
2) run on web/edge runtime (Expo Web or EAS preview)
3) auth token refresh hits retry logic, but fetch resolves with 204 and SDK treats as success => subsequent requests 401

mike: hmm, is this Hermes-only or also JSC?

ana: repro on both. Hermes on device, JSC on web. Problem crops up only when we polyfill globalThis.KV or use a lightweight kv-shim that stashes tokens.

sam: any errors in console? stack traces?

ana: Not super helpful. SDK logs: "cache.get: undefined", then "auth: token expired, calling refresh", then "refresh returned 204: no body" — SDK's retry backoff thinks refresh succeeded and clears pending promises.

jules: can you paste the shim? maybe it returns a truthy empty response.

ana: sure

```
// tiny kv shim used in expo web preview
globalThis.KV = {
  async get(k){ return undefined },
  async put(k,v){ /* noop */ }
}
```

ana: SDK expects null vs undefined and also expects get to throw on misread. TS typings are loose in the SDK so our consumer code assumed get returns string | null but expo shim returns undefined -> type mismatch at runtime.

mike: ugh. two issues: runtime contract + TS signatures. For quick fix can we normalize undefined -> null in SDK at read path?

sam: we should also add a small e2e test that runs with a shim to catch this.

devex-bot: added issue #412 to devex backlog (expo-kv-shim-interop) :white_check_mark:

jules: Also saw an ESM/CJS interop warning when bundling the example: "require() of ES Module not supported" for redwood-inference-js. We should provide dual exports or a small compat entry.

ana: yeah that plus typings export (exports.fields missing) caused TS to import as any in RN projects and lose types for auth helpers.

mike: plan: (1) SDK patch: normalize undefined -> null, throw on unexpected types, add tiny shim helper; (2) add an esm-cjs compat entry in package.json and a types export; (3) add a smoke test on expo/devclient that runs auth refresh flow. I'll own (1).

sam: I'll write the smoke test and add repro to infra.

ana: thanks. anyone urgent need a patch release? we have an enterprise trial blocked.

mike: will cut a patch after PR review today.

ana: :thumbsup: Thanks all.
